name: Ghost
description: The official Ghost image with a MySQL database, its content on a lasting volume and an HTTPS address. Signs in at /ghost/ with the creator's email address and the password shown to the team's owners and admins in the console. Email sending (newsletters, staff invites, password reset) is not set up.

setup.command: node -e 'let p="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>p+=d).on("end",async()=>{const u="http://127.0.0.1:2368/ghost/api/admin/authentication/setup/",h={"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Forwarded-Proto":"https"};let s;for(let i=0;i<120&&!s;i++){s=await fetch(u,{headers:h}).then(r=>r.ok?r.json():null,()=>null);if(!s)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000))}if(!s)process.exit(3);if(s.setup[0].status)process.exit(0);const r=await fetch(u,{method:"POST",headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({setup:[{name:"Owner",email:process.env.CP_ADMIN_EMAIL,password:p.trim(),blogTitle:process.env.CP_APP_NAME}]})});process.exit(r.ok?0:4)})' && touch /var/lib/ghost/content/.cloudploy-ready
